facts.text: the prom Andie walks into on her own
facts.why: Andie arrives at the prom alone but loses her nerve until she sees Duckie, and they walk into the ballroom arm in arm.
facts.fix: the prom Andie walks into in her homemade dress

vibe.verdict: Duckie, the dress and the prom are all in, and the neon look suits the era, but Trax as a stage club is a stretch.
